result.official_quote: No landlord may evict or fail to renew any lease of any premises covered by section 2 of this act except for good cause as defined in section 2.
result.note: Replaced the range 'to -61.12', which no document states, with 'et seq.' because the card merges the good-cause list (61.1), the nonrenewal bar (61.3) and illegal-occupancy relocation (61.1g/61.1h).
